planets.name: TOI-1130 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1130 with a 8.35-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-1130 c was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1130. Its orbit and size follow Borsato et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
